patterns.name: Rising Sun - movable power-chord slides
patterns.description: Clear strings, strike a three-note power chord, slide every fretted voice by three frets, then restrike the destination grip. A5-C5-A5 and D5-F5-D5.

parts.notes: Fresh instrumental demo arrangement of the traditional public-domain song. Standard tuning, no capo, quarter note = 108; count 6/8 ONE-two-three FOUR-five-six (dotted-quarter pulse = 72). Am | C | D | E. Pinch bass and top together; let notes ring. This is accompaniment with original fills, rather than a transcription of a commercial recording or its vocal melody. Rights/background link is in Links.

Am | C | D | F | Am | C | E | E | Am | C | D | F | Am | E | Am | E. Same local picking pattern follows every chord through grip-relative string selection. F uses a full first-fret barre. Instrumental accompaniment; no lyrics or recorded audio included.

parts.section: Rock variation - palm mute and accents
parts.notes: Am | C | D | F | Am | C | E | Am. Keep the bass strokes short; open the hand for the accented chord on eighth-note 4. Dead-note strum on eighth-note 6. Repeated occurrence in the arrangement demonstrates reusable parts.

parts.section: Lead break - legato and power slides
parts.notes: Original demonstration fills, not a quoted recorded solo. Bars 1-4: G string 2h4p2, 5/7/5; high E 0h3p0, B 3p1; C/E turnaround and percussion. Bars 5-8: A5-C5, C5-A5, D5-F5, F5-D5 with synchronized three-string slides. String slaps clear the previous chord before each slide. These power grips reach fret 10. All techniques have a picked or strummed source before the destination.

F | E | Am | Am. Fingerpick F, build on E, knock then stop the penultimate Am with a string slap, and let the last Am ring. Empty action slots contain no new attack; they do not command a rest or choke.
